**Observation Log:**

- [TEMPORAL] Session Date: 2023/05/20 (Sat) 11:35
- [FACT] The user has been living in their new apartment since October 15th last year.
- [PREFERENCE] The user’s personal style is modern and minimalist.
- [FACT] The user’s apartment is around 700 sq ft and is a one-bedroom with an open-plan layout.
- [PREFERENCE] The user prefers a neutral color palette, specifically beige, gray, and white.
- [PREFERENCE] The user wants to make the most of the natural light in their apartment.
- [PREFERENCE] The user has a budget of around $2,000 to $3,000 for decorating.
- [CHANGE] The user recently turned 30 and feels it's time to take their life more seriously, wanting their apartment to reflect that.
- [PREFERENCE] The user likes the idea of a neutral background and light-filled living.
- [PREFERENCE] The user wants to add personal touches to their apartment to make it feel more like home.
- [EVENT] The user has completed a marathon and a triathlon, which they want to reflect in their apartment decor.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant suggested creating a medal display rack or shadow box to showcase the user's marathon and triathlon medals.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant recommended commissioning personalized artwork, specifically a stylized representation of the user's marathon route with subtle design elements reflecting their personality.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant provided several platforms for commissioning artwork: Upwork, Society6, Redbubble, Etsy, MarathonArt, and Run Ink.
- [ASSISTANT_SAID] The assistant advised the user to review the artist's portfolio, discuss project scope, timeline, and pricing, and check feedback and ratings before commissioning.
- [PREFERENCE] The user decided to go with a freelance artist from Upwork for commissioning the artwork.
